en.Der redigierte Gerätebeleg steht in der: Redacted device evidence is available in the Mower variable “Redacted device evidence”.
en.Kein unterstützter Zeitplan empfangen. D: No supported schedule received. The editor requires protocol 0 and seven received daily entries.
en.Der bestätigte Mäherplan wird als native: The confirmed mower schedule is shown in the native Symcon weekly event “Mowing schedule”. Event edits are sent to Worx and confirmed by the schedule returned by the mower.
en.Der Worx-App-Schalter „Ganzer Tag“ änder: The redacted device state was unchanged before and after toggling the all-day switch in the Worx app, so this option is not editable here.
en.Befehlsstatus und bestätigter Mäherzusta: Command status and confirmed mower state are shown separately. An MQTT publish is not device confirmation.
en.Firmware-Auto-Update-Einstellung an die: Firmware auto-update preference sent to Worx Cloud; awaiting confirmation.
en.Firmware-Auto-Update-Einstellung ist ber: Firmware auto-update preference is already confirmed.
en.Firmware-Auto-Update-Einstellung aus der: Firmware auto-update preference read back from Worx Cloud and confirmed.
en.Abweichende Firmware-Auto-Update-Einstel: Different firmware auto-update preference received from Worx Cloud.
en.Keine Cloud-Bestätigung der Firmware-Aut: No confirmation of the firmware auto-update preference from the cloud within 120 seconds.
